posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
If it's this ( [http://www.museeholographie.com/boutiqhomeEN.htm](http://www.museeholographie.com/boutiqhomeEN.htm) ), it could be old Rallison or Augie pieces. I recognise some of the images. At the moment, I believe we and Augie Muth are the only commercial DCG holographers in the US, with the possible exception of Dave Battin and John FP. Augie is dedicated to some artist and Rallison is doing technical so I doubt it's them. So if it isn't Augie or Rallison, it's someone new. Maybe someone bought up the rights and are producing it again. I saw some DCG pieces in a local store (Rite Aid or Long's Pharmacies) stating they were made in China.

I'll make those watches for half of the 25 euros ($33.00)
